Written and merged (57436b4ec): `core/Page/doc/content.md` now has a design section covering all three of your points. Nothing was built, and I did not run the examples.

- **`content` always a List:** it becomes an accessor, and a function, string or address becomes one item in the list. This fixes a bug you'd hit today: a `{"content":…}` jsonl line currently replaces a page's `content` function. It costs a real sweep, because at least 10 classes define `content(){}` in their class body, which would hide the accessor.
